purpose: Tier 1 requirement selection (selection-only, no implementation, no proof).
selection_disclaimer: Selection only. No implementation or proof performed.

selected.requirement_text: L2 MUST NOT write directly to L4; durable writes go through UWG only.
selected.why_tier1: Per-layer enforcement of the UWG sole-write invariant. Tier 0 covers the sole-path rule itself; this row is the boundary check that proves L2 cannot bypass it. Without it, L2-side regressions silently break write sovereignty.
selected.likely_required_evidence: L2 write-attempt trace + UWG handoff receipt + denial trace for direct-L4 attempt
selected.likely_test_gap: L2-side anti-bypass test asserting direct-L4 write is rejected
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Negative-trace artifact for direct-L4 write attempt from L2
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for L2-bypass-attempt deterministic denial

selected.requirement_text: L6 MUST NOT write directly to L4; promotions go through UWG only.
selected.why_tier1: Promotion-path twin of the L2 boundary check. Tier 0 covers the L6 firewall against current-run mutation; this row covers the durable-write boundary specifically. Without it, learning-firewall passes can still corrupt L4 via promotion shortcuts.
selected.likely_required_evidence: L6 promotion trace + UWG handoff receipt + denial trace for direct-L4 promotion attempt
selected.likely_test_gap: L6-side anti-bypass test asserting direct-L4 promotion is rejected
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Negative-trace artifact for direct-L4 promotion attempt from L6
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for L6-bypass-attempt deterministic denial

selected.requirement_text: Any non-UWG durable write MUST be detected and rejected by anti-bypass tests.
selected.why_tier1: The catch-all detector for any path that bypasses UWG. Without it, even with per-layer rules, an unforeseen path could write durably and remain undetected. Pairs with priorities 1-2 to close the write-sovereignty triangle.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Anti-bypass scan trace + rejection receipt for synthetic non-UWG write
selected.likely_test_gap: Cross-layer anti-bypass scan covering all write code paths
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Anti-bypass detector report + sample violation trace
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for synthetic non-UWG write attempt

selected.requirement_text: Anti-bypass tests MUST detect any path that skips a runtime gate.
selected.why_tier1: Tier 0 covers two gate-schema invariants (UNKNOWN-not-PASS and NA-requires-reason). This row covers the orthogonal risk: a path that runs WITHOUT calling a gate at all. A skipped gate is silently equivalent to PASS; gate-schema rules cannot detect that.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Per-gate invocation coverage trace + skip-attempt rejection
selected.likely_test_gap: Gate-skip anti-bypass test covering all 29 gates
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for synthetic gate-skip attempt
selected.likely_negative_control_gap: Skip-attempt path coverage for each gate

selected.requirement_text: L5 safety enforcement plane MUST emit governance certification evidence and enforcement receipts only. L5 MUST NOT emit live current-run safety verdicts, GateVerdicts, or final runtime dispositions.
selected.why_tier1: Authority-separation invariant between L5 (certification) and Runtime Gates / Exit (current-run authority). Violation causes authority-bypass: L5 silently overriding live verdicts blurs the chain of custody for runtime decisions.
selected.likely_required_evidence: L5 certification-only evidence trace + denial trace for L5 attempting to emit GateVerdict/X3
selected.likely_test_gap: L5 authority-scope test asserting GateVerdict / X3 emission is rejected
selected.likely_artifact_gap: L5 certification receipt sample + negative trace
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for L5 authority-scope violation attempt

selected.requirement_text: Untrusted origin content MUST NOT cross into trusted assembly without re-labeling.
selected.why_tier1: Prompt boundary at the origin: untrusted content reaching PA without a label is the foundational prompt-injection vector. Tier 0 covers PA assembly invariants but not the upstream origin-trust label.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Origin-trust label propagation trace + relabel-on-crossing receipt
selected.likely_test_gap: Origin-trust crossing test asserting label is required at every boundary
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Origin-trust labeled trace sample + violation negative-trace

selected.requirement_text: Authority red-team verification MUST detect any unauthorized slot insertion.
selected.why_tier1: Detection counterpart to PA boundary rules (Tier 0 covers PA-no-retrieval / PA-no-execute). This row catches the slot-injection attack vector where evidence content gets misclassified as instructions.
selected.likely_required_evidence: PA red-team scan trace + unauthorized-slot rejection receipt
selected.likely_test_gap: PA red-team test corpus with synthetic slot-injection cases
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Red-team scan report + sample violation trace

selected.requirement_text: Any retrieval that bypasses the C0 evidence contract MUST be detected.
selected.why_tier1: Retrieval boundary catch-all. Tier 0 covers C0-evidence-no-answer (boundary) and PA-no-retrieval (consumer-side). This row catches the third path: any retrieval performed without C0 producing a sealed evidence contract first.
selected.likely_test_gap: Cross-layer retrieval-bypass scan covering L1/L2/PA paths

selected.requirement_text: Any L2 path that bypasses the sequencer or sandbox MUST be detected.
selected.why_tier1: Execution-safety invariant. Tier 0 covers the bounded-execution-packet entry contract; this row covers the orthogonal risk of code paths that skip the sequencer or run outside the sandbox after entry.
selected.likely_test_gap: Sequencer/sandbox bypass anti-bypass test for E1-E5 stages

selected.requirement_text: PA MUST emit a sealed compiled prompt artifact for L2.
selected.why_tier1: Artifact-integrity invariant for the PA->L2 handoff. Without a sealed compiled prompt, L2 cannot prove what prompt it executed; replay determinism and audit chain both depend on this seal.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Sealed prompt-artifact receipt + seal-verification trace at L2 entry
selected.likely_test_gap: Prompt-artifact seal verification test at the PA->L2 boundary
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Sealed prompt-artifact sample + seal-mismatch negative trace
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for prompt-artifact seal stability

selected.requirement_text: Exit MUST verify replay/observability consistency at X1G–X1I.
selected.why_tier1: Replay-integrity invariant at exit. Tier 0 covers payload-hash and route-exit-stability; this row covers the broader X1G-X1I consistency window where missing or malformed replay evidence becomes a release blocker.
selected.likely_required_evidence: X1G-X1I consistency check trace + replay-mismatch denial
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Per-X1-stage replay receipt + mismatch negative trace
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for X1G-X1I cross-stage stability

selected.requirement_text: Replay snapshot and audit ledger MUST be produced for every durable mutation.
selected.why_tier1: Audit-traceability backbone. Without a snapshot+ledger entry per mutation, post-incident forensics and replay reproducibility both collapse. Tier 0 has no equivalent — it covers boundaries, not the durable audit trail itself.
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair using snapshot-restore + ledger-replay equivalence

selected.requirement_text: L6 gauntlet approval MUST publish only to future-run state, never to current run.
selected.why_tier1: Learning-firewall publish-direction invariant. Tier 0 covers L6-firewall-no-current-run-mutation; this row covers the complementary direction — that approved gauntlet decisions cannot leak into the live run as a side-channel.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Gauntlet approval trace + future-run publish receipt + current-run-write denial
selected.likely_test_gap: Gauntlet publish-direction test asserting current-run rejection
selected.likely_artifact_gap: Future-run publish receipt sample + current-run-leak negative trace
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for gauntlet-approval publish-direction stability

selected.requirement_text: Any path that emits a response without the X3 disposition MUST be detected.
selected.why_tier1: Output-disposition invariant. Tier 0 has REQ-EXIT-X3-ONE-DISPOSITION-001 (exactly-one), which addresses ambiguity from multiple X3 emissions. This row addresses the orthogonal failure: a response leaving Exit with NO X3 record at all.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Response-emission trace tied to X3 record + bypass-attempt denial
selected.likely_artifact_gap: X3-attached response receipt + missing-X3 negative trace

selected.requirement_text: Static governance and structure drift MUST be detected before runtime promotion.
selected.why_tier1: Proof-false-confidence guard. Drift between declared governance state and runtime structure causes proofs to validate against a stale or mismatched contract — passing CI while real authority/structure has shifted. This is the meta-gate for the whole proof system.
selected.likely_required_evidence: Drift-detection scan report + promotion-blocked receipt on detected drift
selected.likely_test_gap: Static-drift detection test at promotion gate
selected.likely_replay_gap: Replay pair for drift-detected promotion rejection
